Las autoridades instaron a los habitantes a evacuar la zona ante el riesgo de contaminación. El Ejército argumentó que la explosión vigilada era necesaria porque el deterioro del material podía llegar a causar un estallido sin control. item.title: Man nailed himself inside a box to escape slavery in 1849
item.description: Henry Box Brown escaped slavery in 1849 by having himself packed inside a wooden box and transported from Richmond, Virginia, to Philadelphia. The 26-27-hour journey involved several changes of transport, and the box was turned upside down twice, nearly costing him his life. After reaching freedom, Brown became an abolitionist speaker and performer, sharing his escape story across the US and England. He later returned to the US and died in Toronto in 1897. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
